thread:
Jordan (Sales): FYI Polaris Biotech is pushing back on their pilot invoice. They say usage spiked during load testing and want a one-time credit + a discounted pilot rate for the next 3 months. Asking for 40% off.
Mia F.: Can you share numbers? We need scope: committed tokens, actual billed tokens, invoice ID, and whether they signed the pilot T&C.
Jordan (Sales): Invoice INV-2026-334 for $9,000, billed vs expected was +120% over forecast. They ask for $3.6k credit (40%) plus a retro pilot SKU for upcoming months. They claim the spike was system-test traffic from their infra team.
Ravi (Finance): Delegation note — Finance can approve up to 25% for pilots <= $50k. 40% needs escalation + prepay or PO. Also need documented reason for overage (support ticket or postmortem).
Priya CSM: We have support ticket #SUP-8892 showing they ran large synthetic tests without notifying us. CSM recommends a partial goodwill credit but not full 40% unless Sales secures a case study + prepay.
Jordan (Sales): Polaris offered a logo + technical case study if we do 30% off and waive the setup fee. They won't prepay but will sign a 3-month pilot amendment committing to a minimum monthly token bucket.
Sam R-Ops: For billing, RevOps can create a one-off credit memo and a temporary pilot rate SKU. Example billing entries we can create:
```
CREDIT_MEMO: CM-2290-001
AppliesTo: INV-2026-334
Amount: -3600.00
Reason: Pilot goodwill credit (partial)

RATECARD SKU: POLARIS_PILOT_3M
UnitPrice: $0.0065 / 1k tokens (pilot rate)
Term: 3 months
```
Leah (Legal): Legal will need the pilot amendment signed. We also want a clause that the credit is one-time goodwill; the pilot rate expires automatically and reverts to standard pricing. Also include a clause that synthetic/system tests must be coordinated with Redwood or they count toward billable usage.
Ravi (Finance): Conditional approval path: Finance will approve up to 30% total (so immediate concession to 30%) if Sales obtains: (1) signed amendment, (2) PO or 50% prepay, (3) support postmortem confirming test traffic. Anything >30% requires Director signoff.
Priya CSM: I can attach SUP-8892 and draft the postmortem within 48h. Will also confirm whether 20+ onboarding hours justify waiving setup fee.
Jordan (Sales): I'll push for the 30% deal and the case study. Polaris verbally agreed to logo + short tech writeup if we bump to 30%. No prepay yet — asking for net30 PO.
Mia F.: Finance prefers prepay but can accept PO with credit hold release upon PO receipt. If PO is net30, we need a signed amendment with a clause for retroactive credit memo and explicit timeline for invoice adjustments.
Sam R-Ops: I'll open RDW-4987 to create CM-2290-001 and the POLARIS_PILOT_3M SKU once Finance confirms % and we have amendment + PO attached to the ticket.
billing-bot: Created credit memo draft CM-2290-001 (status: pending approval).
Ravi (Finance): Approving 30% concession pending: signed amendment + PO uploaded to the deal by EOD Tue. If we don't get PO/prepay, concession reverts to 20% and CSM must log onboarding hours.
Jordan (Sales): Noted. I'll get amendment signed and push PO. Will update thread when PO arrives.
Priya CSM: Drafting amendment and onboarding estimate now. ETA EOD Monday. :memo:
Leah (Legal): I'll review the amendment and add the "synthetic test" coordination clause. Expect comments by tomorrow.
billing-bot: CM-2290-001 moved to approved after Finance sign-off (30%); will apply to next billing cycle when PO attached.
